newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1997 soybean, oil shipments sharply up-SGS.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1997 soybean, oil shipments sharply up-SGS.

text.p: Brazilian exports of soybeans and soyoil rose sharply in the first two months of 1997 compared with the same period last year, inspection company SGS do Brasil said.
Soybean shipments were 43,500 tonnes, compared with none last year. Meanwhile, soyoil shipments rose to 96,300 tonnes from 77,100 tonnes in the same period in 1996.
But shipments of soymeal fell to 702,300 tonnes from 1.157 million tonnes in the first two months of 1996.
Corn shipments were also sharply up to 202,000 tonnes in January and February, compared with none last year.
Paranagua port remained the main soy shipper with 276,900 tonnes soymeal and 43,500 tonnes of soybeans in the first two months of 1997. Of the soybeans, 500 tonnes were from Paraguay.
